blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No bettor won the jackpots in the Ultra Lotto 6/58, Super Lotto 6/49 and Lotto 6/42 draws Tuesday, Sept. 22, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO). The Ultra Lotto 6/58 winning combination was 18-03-22-20-19-43 for a jackpot of ₱322.26 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. The Super Lotto 6/49 combination was 25-15-38-37-29-06, with a jackpot of ₱25.34 million. There was no jackpot winner. READ: Lotto Results Today – September 22, 2026 For Lotto 6/42, the winning numbers were 11-26-07-16-35-23 for a ₱53.85 million jackpot. No ticket holder won the top prize.
